title: Fix AuthRepository.logout return contract
objective: Make logout return AsyncResult<void> success semantics instead of leaking SharedPreferencesService's boolean/string result type.
acceptance_criteria: AuthRepository.logout returns Success.unit or Success(unit()) on successful local logout cleanup
logout no longer returns tokenResult or another non-void SharedPreferences result directly
Failures while clearing stored UUID/token are logged and handled consistently with the repository contract
AuthRepository local auth state is cleared before the success result is returned
flutter analyze for auth repository files reports no new errors
